tweets.text:
@llamareceipts Almost none of the "AI agent" fee narrative is real: only 3 of 10 tokens with tracked fees grew quarter-over-quarter, and Virtuals Protocol is doing basically all the heavy lifting.

Methodology: DefiLlama's ai-agents + decentralized-ai categories, 23 tokenized protocols, only 10 with enough fee history to compare Jul 1-Sep 16 vs the matched Apr 1-Jun 16 span.

Growing:
- @virtuals_io: $3.20M vs $908K (+253%)
- Creator Bid: $12.1K vs $3.9K (+209%, tiny base)
- ZyFAI: $23.3K vs $10.9K (+114%)

Flat/declining:
- MorpheusAI: $89.6K vs $85.1K (+5%)
- OpenLedger: $101K vs $127K (-20%)
- Capx AI: $54.4K vs $204K (-73%)
- Vader AI: $4.3K vs $19.8K (-78%)
- Giza: $2.3K vs $17.1K (-87%)
- FLock.​io: $5.6K vs $43.5K (-87%)
- MiroShark: $17.5K vs $147K (-88%)

Fees = revenue for all of these. Virtuals' 30d run-rate (~$693K/mo) still trades at ~46x P/S. The other 13 category members (Infinit, Botto, Arbius, Mind Network, etc.) show zero tracked fees at all.

Not financial advice.
